does: Rolls one requested roll on the server: gets the roller's stream (the Dialog stream of a player for a dialogue check), copies the rolled result into the request, decides the verdict - a natural 20 succeeds, a natural 1 fails, else success when the difficulty is at most the total - and writes the natural die, the discarded die (only when advantage and disadvantage differ) and the verdict into the request.

evidence.says: GK.Memory.Watch on a new passive check's eoc::RequestedRollComponent, armed in the tick the request appeared: its NaturalRoll (+0x42) written at +0x3296664 and +0x4C written at +0x3296682 (1 on a pass: natural 13 total over DC 10; read 0 on a fail: total 12 against DC 99), and its Result written through +0xF1889D from +0x32961CE; return chain into SystemUpdate<esv::RollSystem> (+0x2390BAC) via +0x32937EF, +0x32981CF; the decompiler's weak pairing with the Toolkit's esv::RollSystem::RollDice
